hypothesis: Relaxing only SOL range-onset's hourly-cross blocker when side-adjusted OPI is aligned may add profitable bidirectional, portfolio-compatible range opportunities at a fixed 60-minute horizon.
decision: Reject the frozen v1 rule for execution and preserve its removal from the staged profile. All nine prospective paths were portfolio-deployable, yet the aggregate remained materially negative. Keep unchanged observations report-only under the ungated-experiment charter; any changed mechanism requires a new identity and cutoff.
falsifier: A prospectively frozen changed mechanism with positive after-cost net return and profit factor above one across multiple windows and both directions would update this rejection; any source-prefix or decision-time regime-lineage failure invalidates the current decision.
limitations: All resolved paths are long despite the bidirectional contract.
Recorded adverse BBO estimates are not venue fills.
The fixed-hour horizon isolates entry quality rather than a complete adaptive exit.
The observer may continue reporting outcomes, but unchanged-rule observations do not authorize retrospective retuning.
